title: Get the new BCQuality plugin for VS Code!
summary: BCQuality is an open-source Microsoft repository that helps AI agents and AL developers generate better code for Business Central by encoding known AI mistakes. A new VS Code plugin now makes it easier to use by automatically downloading repository files and requiring only the mention of 'BCQuality' in prompts instead of URLs.
key_points: BCQuality focuses on fixing common AI errors rather than general best practices
The new VS Code plugin automatically installs and updates repository files locally
Users can install the plugin through VS Code's Command Palette without manual setup
The repository includes knowledge and skills subfolders in community and microsoft folders
Automatic updates check roughly every 24 hours or can be triggered manually

quotes.text: It only encodes the things AI gets wrong.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that BCQuality's unique value is correcting AI mistakes, not general coding standards
